Your privacy

Privacy Policy

Eye Trends Vision & Glasses Center (Dr. Jerry Hyder, OD), Clear Lake / Houston, TX. This is the privacy policy for the website of Eye Trends Vision & Glasses Center (Dr. Jerry Hyder, OD), comprehensive eye care & optical in Clear Lake / Houston. It explains, in plain language, what information we collect when you use this site or reach out to us, how we use it, and how to ask us a question about it.

Effective date: August 2026

On this page

  • What we collect
  • How we use it
  • Health information and HIPAA
  • Cookies and website analytics
  • Your choices
  • How to reach us
A note before you read: the following is written in plain language so it is easy to follow. It is our draft wording, and it is subject to review and approval by the practice and its counsel before it becomes final.

What we collect

We collect the information you choose to give us. When you ask for an appointment or send us a message, that is usually your name, your phone number, your email, and a short note about the reason for your visit, so we know how to help and how to reach you back. When you become a patient, our office also keeps the records that go with your care. And like most websites, this site records some standard technical information about your visit, which we describe under cookies and website analytics below.

How we use it

We use your information to do the things you came here for: to schedule your visit, to provide and follow up on your eye care, and to keep this website working and easy to use. We do not sell your information, and we do not trade it to anyone to market to you. If we ever need to share something to actually provide your care, we do it only for that purpose.

Health information and HIPAA

Your medical records and the health information tied to your care are protected health information, and they are handled under the separate HIPAA Notice of Privacy Practices that governs the records at our office, not by this website policy. This page is about the website. If you want to know how your medical information is handled once you are a patient, that Notice of Privacy Practices is the document that covers it, and we are glad to give you a copy.

Cookies and website analytics

This site uses cookies and standard website analytics, the same everyday tools most sites use to remember your preferences and to understand which pages people find useful, so we can keep the site clear and current. This is general website information about how the site is used. Most browsers let you limit or turn off cookies in their settings if you would rather.

Your choices

You have a say in your information. You can ask us what we have, ask us to correct it, and tell us how you would prefer to hear from us. We keep the information you share with us reasonably secure and treat it with care. From time to time we may update this policy as our practice or the website changes, and when we do, the effective date at the top will tell you when the current version took effect.

Questions about your privacy

Have a question about this policy, or about the information you have shared with us? Reach the same Clear Lake office that has looked after this community for 42 years, here since 1984. A real person answers, not a phone tree, and we will be glad to help.
